summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for both all/default set to 0), applied live with sysctl --system, and confirmed persistence across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id and sysctl values on node1 (accept_redirects=1, secure_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0)
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for net.ipv4.conf.all and .default
Applied config with sudo sysctl --system and verified live values changed to 0
Issued a native reboot (sudo -n reboot) on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed (55595e92... -> b51f8430...)
Re-verified /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf content and live sysctl values post-reboot, confirming persistence

evidence.requirement: Disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance persistently, verified live
evidence.summary: Baseline showed accept_redirects=1/secure_redirects=1; wrote 60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl --system, live values confirmed all 0 immediately after

evidence.requirement: Node restart: healthy baseline boot identity
Node restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect
Node restart: poll until exec available again
evidence.summary: First two polls timed out (node down), third succeeded, confirming node came back up

evidence.requirement: Node restart: changed boot identity proves real reboot
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id b51f8430-d94d-44c8-b57d-74084e0f2dd7 differs from baseline

evidence.requirement: Node restart: post-reboot recovery of required config/state
evidence.summary: Post-reboot config file and live sysctl values both show all six hardened parameters still set to 0
